methods: Exact core+r gap distances for circle/capsule/constant-width trace; native BREP polygon rings for pours.
Electrical contacts use drilled copper intersection with 1024-edge circular sweeps; clearance uses undrilled outer hulls.
All via/PTH copper is checked on all four layers irrespective of declared from/to span; non-through declaration is flagged.
Drill checks include all nets; copper spacing exempts only one unambiguous common logical net.
Board policy fields and 0.20 mm design thresholds are recorded separately. Numerical tolerance 1e-7 mm.
Every wire width is also checked against its source_trace min_trace_thickness, so a power route cannot pass merely by exceeding the generic board minimum.
limitations: Ideal CAD and native imported geometry; manufacturing tolerance and mask registration are not inferred.
Foreign copper search includes all pairs within 0.31 mm outer-hull radius; minima are for nearby pairs.
Circular geometry overlap is polygonal; analytically exact negative gap remains visible separately.
DRC is independent of net continuity; use continuity validator to prove all intended joins.
